component: Multi-message Exchange offline fetch queue and per-message state

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fetcher copies input keys in reverse, reads LastElement and pops the key after its fetch completes. This preserves caller order while using a stack. It resets output stream and byte count before starting the next message, and continues only after successful storage/header updates. Failure stops the remaining queue and reaches the completion callback. The channel still passes a one-key list. This source does not establish parallel fetching, rollback of already stored earlier messages or full cancellation. No offline download ran.
title: Offline fetch uses a reversed key stack to preserve sequential input order
